description: This Java class defines a custom exception named `ClientCollateralCannotBeDeletedException` used within the collateral management module of the Fineract system. It indicates reasons why client collateral cannot be deleted, such as being attached to a loan collateral.

classes.name: ClientCollateralCannotBeDeletedException
classes.description: Custom exception class indicating client collateral deletion issues within collateral management.

classes.name: ClientCollateralCannotBeDeletedReason
classes.description: Enumeration of specific reasons why a client collateral cannot be deleted, with methods to generate error messages and codes.

methods.name: ClientCollateralCannotBeDeletedException
methods.description: Constructor for the exception, initializes it with a specific reason and loan collateral ID.

methods.name: errorMessage
methods.description: Returns a human-readable error message based on the reason enum.

methods.name: errorCode
methods.description: Returns an error code string corresponding to the reason enum.
